scope_of_deliverables.value: The City of Medicine Hat is seeking a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: The City of Medicine Hat (“the City”) is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the pricing form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has submitted a proposal for, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: (Proponent's Price / Lowest Price) x 100 = Proponent's Price Percentage. The lowest price will receive 100% of the points allocated to price.
